title: Service courses
venueBody: Set when products are served at this branch. To configure another branch, use the main branch switcher.
orgBody: Edit your business’s shared list. Branches using their own courses will keep their settings.
venueEditBody: These changes apply only to this branch. Customizing copies the whole list and stops inheriting organization changes.
orgEditBody: Changes apply to branches that inherit this list. Branches with their own courses are not modified.
organizationTitle: Want to configure courses for your whole business?
organizationBody: Go to the organization dashboard to edit the shared list. Each branch can inherit it or use its own courses.
organizationOwnerOnly: The organization owner can configure the shared list in their dashboard.
inheritCount: {{count}} of {{total}} branches inherit the shared list.
overrideBody: This branch does not receive shared-list changes. You can restore inheritance anytime.
readOnly: You can view these courses. Editing requires settings permission.
orgProBody: Configurable service courses are included in Pro, like Tables and Combos. Enable Pro at a branch in this organization to edit the shared list. Each branch needs Tables access to use it in the POS.
comboBody: In restaurant or café mode, each product in a combo or bundle can have its own service course. Preparation and delivery are tracked per product; the combo price stays the same.
immediateMeaning: Prepared without waiting for another course. You can rename it; this behavior stays the same.
historical: Orders and combos already sent keep the names chosen when ordering, even if a course is renamed or removed.
restoreBody: This branch’s own list will be replaced with the current organization list. Previous orders will keep their courses.
loadError: Could not load courses for this context. Check your access and try again.
saveError: Could not save courses. Your draft is kept; check your access and try again.
conflict: Courses changed while you were editing. Your draft is kept. Review the current version before saving.
reloadBody: This draft will be replaced with the latest saved courses.
discardBody: Changes in this draft have not been saved yet.

validation.name: Each course needs a name up to {{length}} characters, without control characters.
validation.duplicate: Use a different name for each course.
validation.immediate: The immediate course must remain first.
